composition.title: Composition
composition.intro: What this deployment carries, and why. Composition is a **deployment** decision: it arrives through this environment's values file (helm → ConfigMap → environment variables), so this page reports it rather than editing it — a change made here would be reverted by the next `helm upgrade`.

registrationKeys.heading: Registration keys
registrationKeys.hint: A registration key (`mwr_…`) lets a NEW installation register itself on first startup — no token copying. Installations registered with a key belong to the admin who minted it; revoking the key stops further registrations without touching existing installations. Revoke applies to keys you minted yourself.

instancePlan.hint: The plan on the instance record is the licence every package fetch is decided against: an instance may pull the packages its plan covers, from the sources it is granted. New instances start on the free plan. Set a higher plan here; it takes effect on the next request.

ui.mdPublishedIntro:
Every page a **logged-out visitor** can open — the same list `/sitemap.xml` gives crawlers, read from the same enumeration so the two cannot drift.

A page is public because it carries an **Anonymous Read grant**. There is no separate switch and no separate location: its public URL is its ordinary path. Change it on the node's **Access** tab.
ui.mdPublishedNone: **Nothing is published.** No node carries an Anonymous Read grant, so a logged-out visitor sees nothing and `/sitemap.xml` is empty.

setup.title: Set up this instance
setup.intro: This portal has no database yet. Answer these questions once and it will restart configured.
setup.done.detail: The instance is restarting with the configuration you chose. Reload this page in a moment.
setup.token.label: Setup token
setup.token.help: Printed once to this instance's log when it started without a database. It stops a stranger from configuring the portal before you do.
setup.token.invalid: That setup token is not the one this instance printed at startup.
setup.storage.heading: Database
setup.storage.help: Where this instance keeps everything. SQLite needs nothing installed and is the right choice for a single machine; the others expect a server you already run.
setup.signin.heading: Sign-in
setup.signin.help: How people get in. Choose at least one — an instance with no sign-in route is one nobody can enter.
setup.signin.devLogin.help: Signs you in without any identity provider, and creates the account on first use. Never turn this on for an instance the internet can reach.

setup.ai.help: Keys for the language models this instance may call. You can add more later; an instance with none simply has an empty model picker.
setup.ai.embedding.heading: Embeddings
setup.ai.embedding.help: An OpenAI-compatible /v1/embeddings endpoint. Without one, search falls back to matching words instead of meaning — silently, so it is worth setting now.
setup.modules.heading: Modules
setup.modules.help: Which of the modules in this image start with the instance.
setup.modules.packages.help: Installed from the plugin registry at first boot. A pattern such as Plugins/* covers what the source serves today and what it publishes tomorrow.

setup.hello.intro: One question first: what this instance is called. It then registers itself so it can see the plugins your plan includes, and the rest of setup is chosen from those.

setup.identity.help: The name is yours to pick and change. The id below is generated — it is what the registry knows this instance by.

setup.identity.id.help: Generated for you, and claimed permanently once you continue. Ids are never re-issued, so this one stays yours.

setup.identity.key.help: Leave blank for the free plan. Enter a key only if someone gave you one for a paid plan.

setup.packages.help: What your plan includes. Tick what this instance should install on first start; you can add more later from the Store.

activity.import.keptLocalChange: ↩ Kept local change to {path} (newer on the server — commit to sync it back).
activity.import.strandedByNodeType: ⚠ {path}: written with NodeType '{nodeType}', which this source does not carry ahead of it and the mesh does not have. The node is STRANDED until that type lands — it will read as Unavailable. Import the source that defines it, or retype the node.
activity.import.keptServerAddition: ↩ Kept {path} (added on the server — commit to sync it back).
activity.prune.strandedInstances: ⚠ Pruned {count} NodeType(s) that still have instances — those instances are now STRANDED: they have no per-node hub, so they read as Unavailable and render empty. Retype or delete them, or restore the NodeType: {detail}.
activity.writeConflict.merged: A write at Version={staleVersion} lost the race against the durable Version={latestVersion} on '{path}' and was merged into it.
activity.writeConflict.durableRow: The durable row: nodeType='{nodeType}' name='{name}' category='{category}' mainNode='{mainNode}' lastModifiedBy='{lastModifiedBy}'.
activity.writeConflict.memberOverwritten: '{member}' was not auto-resolvable — the newer value was kept and the losing write's value dropped.
activity.writeConflict.memberMerged: '{member}' was merged — both writes' content survives.
menu.modelCreditTooltip: Model usage and what it cost
ui.modelCreditBillIntro: Every round run on the platform's model key, priced when it was spent. Rows show the currency the round was actually charged in; the period total against your plan's allowance is shown only when a conversion rate has been declared.
ui.modelCreditSignedOut: Sign in to see your model usage.
ui.modelCreditUnreadable: This period's charges could not be read just now, so nothing is shown rather than an incomplete bill. Please try again in a few minutes.
ui.modelCreditRefused: You can only see your own bill, so this is yours.
ui.modelCreditNoRows: No model usage recorded for this period.
ui.modelCreditConfigIntro: Providers, their models and their prices, and the tiers that decide which model is used for what. A provider's key is write-only: it is set on the provider's own page and is never displayed or read back.
ui.modelCreditPlanUnknown: Your plan could not be read, so there is nothing to measure this period against.
ui.modelCreditUnmetered: This plan is unmetered — rounds are not billed against an allowance.
ui.modelCreditTotalUndeterminedCurrency: Allowance **{0}**. The total for this period is **undetermined**: a charge is priced in {1} and the allowance is in {2}, and no conversion has been declared. Nothing is converted at a rate nobody wrote down and no row is dropped, so no total is shown. An operator declares one by creating `{3}`.
ui.modelCreditTotalUndeterminedRead: Allowance **{0}**. The total for this period is **undetermined** — a charge could not be read. This is not a zero, and it is not a limit on your plan.
ui.modelCreditNoRates: No conversion rate is declared. A period whose charges are not all in the plan's currency therefore has no total — which is the intended behaviour, not a failure.
ui.modelCreditRateMismatch: ⚠️ {0}: the recorded mid and margin do not produce the rate being applied. The rate on the node is what converts the total — the figures beside it are shown as recorded and are never used to recompute it.
ui.providerNoModels: No models configured. Add one from the Models catalog — give it a price per million tokens and a currency, so what a round costs is decided here rather than by the platform's built-in price table.
ui.providerModelsUnreadable: This provider's models could not be read just now, so none are shown rather than an empty catalog.
ui.providerModelsUnpriced: {0} {1}: no price on the model and none in the platform's built-in table, so rounds on these models are NOT billed — the platform pays for them and the ledger records nothing.
ui.providerModelsNoCurrency: {0} {1}: priced, but in no declared currency — the meter falls back to a default, so the bill states a currency the model never named.
ui.providerModelsFallback: {0} {1}: no price is set on the model, so the platform's built-in price table is used — the rate shown is that fallback, and rounds ARE billed. Set a price on the model to override it.
